text: Understanding databases is an important skill for anyone working with data. Databases store and organise information so it can be easily accessed and updated. Traditional SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, and you write queries to retrieve exactly what you need. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and handle unstructured data well. Good data modelling helps you design an efficient structure from the start. Indexes are also essential because they speed up searches, especially in large tables. Choosing between SQL and NoSQL depends on your project's needs, so it is worth learning the basics of both.
